fintech_landing.brief: Landing page first screen for a Series-A fintech, 'Ledger' — a treasury platform that lets finance teams see every bank account, card and payout in one place. Audience: CFOs and controllers at 50–500 person companies. Must feel trustworthy, precise, fast.

judge.reason: Polished trustworthy treasury story with instant clarity, but the live ticker, badge, and dense dashboard compete with the headline for focus.

diagnosis: Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
Place areas (PPA/RSC) dominate: the background scene swallows the message
Attention drops after the first 2 s (+0.60 → +0.43): nothing to look at after the first impression
directives: Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
Simplify the environment: crop or blur the scene, put copy on a solid panel, let one subject own the frame.
Add a second discovery after the hero (a detail reveal, micro-illustration, or a strong secondary block) so interest holds past 2 s.
